[Plus, how Every’s head of growth stays focused and some aggressively casual language](https://every.)  by [Laura Entis](https://every.)     Midjourney/Every illustration.  LLMs make a lot of life [searchable](https://every.), from meeting transcripts to iMessages to half-formed morning thoughts, but all this context only helps if you know what you want to achieve. Today, we’re revisiting how AI entrepreneur **[Noah Brier](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9Abm9haF8xNzI5IiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjZ9)** uses Claude Code as a second brain to sharpen and expand his own ideas, Every head of growth **[Austin Tedesco](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AdGVkZXNjYXUiLCJwb3NpdGlvbiI6N30=)** shares how Codex helped him spot the interruptions crowding out deeper work, and we offer a workflow for mining your scattered past insights into a coherent draft.  *Was this newsletter forwarded to you? [Sign up](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9hY2NvdW50IiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjh9) to get it in your inbox.*     ---    **Spotlight****[Noah Brier](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9Abm9haF8xNzI5IiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjl9), AI entrepreneur and seer** Brier is a true AI early adopter. The cofounder of the AI consultancy [Alephic](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYWxlcGhpYy5jb20vIiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjEwfQ==), Brier was all in on using Claude Code as a [“second brain”](https://every.) for knowledge work back when most people still viewed the tool as a place to write code.  In September, Brier told **[Dan Shipper](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9AZGFuc2hpcHBlciIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjoxMn0=)** on our podcast, *[AI & I](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by9wb2RjYXN0IiwicG9zaXRpb24iOjEzfQ==)*, how he turned the coding app into a research, thinking, and writing partner by connecting it to thousands of his personal notes. Since then, he’s started thinking beyond  his own productivity—how does AI make it easier or harder for an entire organization to stay working toward the same goal? For that, he has a new framework, [announced in Every last week](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by90aGVzaXMvdGhlLWN1bHR1cmUtb2YtYWktZW5naW5lZXJpbmciLCJwb3NpdGlvbiI6MTR9), that he calls the “pace layers” of AI engineering, drawn from **Stewart Brand**’s system for describing how different parts of society change at different speeds.  Just as hooking up Claude Code to an ocean of personal information requires you to determine what is—and isn’t—worth surfacing, running a successful AI company relies on human judgment. Similarly, AI makes code free to produce, but it doesn’t make it easier to identify a product people actually want or orient an entire system of humans and agents around that vision.  Read Brier’s [essay](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9ldmVyeS50by90aGVzaXMvdGhlLWN1bHR1cmUtb2YtYWktZW5naW5lZXJpbmclNUMiLCJwb3NpdGlvbiI6MTV9) on the framework he uses to achieve alignment and then watch his *AI & I* episode on [YouTube](https://every.to/emails/click/136f006095268802530f927779a5f4d55a493840c0f1f77c950761a77b64df9e/eyJzdWJqZWN0IjoiTWluaW5nIFlvdXIgTGlmZSBmb3IgQ29udGV4dCAiLCJwb3N0X2lkIjo0MTk0LCJwb3N0X3R5cGUiOiJwb3N0IiwidXJsIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9pbjdpLUVWRERsayIsInBvc2l0aW9uIjoxNn0=), or listen on [Spotify](https://every.) or [Apple Podcasts](https://every.).
